title: The Sky Smiled
about: Episode 9, 25 s, made for views: episode 1's 'make people smile' at planetary scale. Hook in the first second (a giant smiley reflected in an eye), a jaw-drop reveal (thousands of drones forming a smiley over a city), the cost (every window and every face the same smile), and the answer (a child's crooked hand-drawn smiley). The two hero shots use the bigger Wan 14B; one grade and grain over all. Silent film for the user's own music; only the last line is written.

scenes.prompt: cinematic extreme macro close-up of a human eye at night, in the glossy reflection of the iris a gigantic glowing yellow smiley face hangs in the dark sky above a city skyline, the pupil slowly widens in awe, tiny city lights reflected, ultra detailed, shallow depth of field, static camera

epic cinematic aerial shot at night, thousands of glowing yellow drones hover in formation forming one colossal perfect smiley face in the sky above a vast glittering city skyline, tiny crowds on the rooftops look up in awe, breathtaking scale, slow push-in

cinematic close-up at night, a swarm of small round white flying drones, each with one large glowing blue eye, hovering in perfect formation against a dark sky, lit warm yellow from below, shallow depth of field, static camera

cinematic wide shot at night, a dense city where every window and every giant billboard screen glows with the same yellow smiley face, crowds standing still in the street below all wearing identical bright yellow smiley-face masks and looking up, eerie yellow light, static camera

cinematic close-up at night on a rooftop, a small child's hand holds up a crooked hand-drawn smiley face in crayon on a sheet of paper against the glowing yellow sky, the paper trembles in the wind, tender, shallow depth of field, static camera
scenes.say: We only get to teach it once.
